why: CairnCommons/notes/_charter+why.json declares 'the owner: the notes store owns writes; the single commons emit chokepoint validates every record against the template below (Law 6).' Measured 2026-08-04: 3 of 25 records conform to that template. Twenty-two do not. So either the chokepoint is not wired for this store or every writer has bypassed it — and in both cases the store's own charter states a gate that does not run. The lived symptom: 'how many times has /note fired?' has no honest answer from the directory, because 22 of the files in it were never written by /note. A count of the folder reports /note as the second-busiest skill in Cairn on the strength of hand-written design documents that merely share its address.

occurrences.identity: CairnCommons/notes/ — the store, and whatever chokepoint its charter believes guards it
occurrences.location: CairnCommons/notes/_charter+why.json (the `owner` field naming the chokepoint, and the `template` object it says is validated); the 25 records beside it
occurrences.code: "owner": "the notes store owns writes; the single commons emit chokepoint validates every record against the template below (Law 6)."
occurrences.expected: Every record in CairnCommons/notes/ carries the template's required fields: id, date, author, text. A write that does not is refused at the chokepoint before it lands.
occurrences.actual: 3 of 25 conform. CONFORMING: cairn-command-and-bin.json, held-edge-g-survey-face.json, maintenance-is-an-axis-not-a-class.json. NON-CONFORMING: 22, of which 22 are missing `text` (the store's central field), 19 are missing `author`, and 1 is missing `date`. The non-conforming records carry ~180 distinct hand-authored field names between them (the_view, akien_verbatim_2026_08_01, cc_read_neurology, FIRST_TASK_the_cascade, …), which is the signature of direct writes rather than a door with a shape.
occurrences.how_measured: python3 — load CairnCommons/notes/_charter+why.json, take template keys whose description does not contain 'optional' as required, then check membership across every *.json in the directory excluding _charter+why.json. Re-runnable; no state read.
occurrences.fatality: non-fatal, and that is the problem — nothing has broken, so nothing has surfaced it. The store has been quietly holding two different kinds of artifact under one charter for three weeks.
occurrences.what_it_blocks: the /note disuse clause. Akien, 2026-08-04: '/note ... could wind up being excised through disuse.' Excision needs a firing count, a firing count needs to distinguish a note from a held document, and today that distinction exists only as a template nothing enforces. skills/note/intention+why.json now declares counted_by with conform_to_template: true, which makes the count honest by FILTERING at read time — a workaround that reads correctly and enforces nothing.
occurrences.the_two_dispositions: Either (a) the chokepoint gets wired for this store and the 22 non-conforming records are migrated to the store they actually belong in — there is a strong case they are HELD DESIGN NOTES, a different kind with a different half-life, and the `held-` filename prefix on 15 of them says the writers already knew it; or (b) the template is wrong about what a note is, and the charter should be corrected to describe the store as it is actually used. What is NOT a disposition is leaving a charter that claims a gate it does not have (Law 4: a rule that matters is enforced by physics, not policy — until it is, it is a tracked debt, and this file is that debt).

found_by: the skilldial counted_by build, 2026-08-04 — measuring where each skill's firings actually live turned up the store whose declared shape and actual contents disagree. Found from the far end: nobody was auditing the notes store; the count needed a denominator and the denominator was not what it claimed to be.
traces_to: Law 4 (a rule that matters is enforced by physics, not policy)
Law 6 (everything has exactly one owner; the owner alone gates writes)
Law 3 (nothing is known until measured — the conformance number is the whole content of this trouble)
